notes: Incremental OMOP CONCEPT load. Author's pattern kept verbatim: %sysfunc(exist()) guard, PROC SQL union with anti-join (where oct.concept_id is null) to add only new concept_ids, then PROC DATASETS delete temp / change live->bkup / change _in->live. Exercises the 'vocabulary already exists' merge branch with 3 existing + 4 extract rows -> 5 deduplicated concepts. Source script reads vocab.concept_temp from omop_vocab\CONCEPT.csv via INFILE; here it is staged inline so the bundle is self-contained for the runner (which submits script only). Two-level vocab. names mapped to work tables in autoexec.
